_readme: Browser client tools for the Gemini Sandbox voice assistant. Credentials, device pairing and transcript confirmation evidence are added only by the browser. Hosted deployments without device pairing use private dashboard approval.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Find sandbox prediction markets by topic, event-wide USD volume or expiry. Each event has ticker, title, volume_usd and contracts; each contract has symbol, label, expiry and outcome prices in dollars. Use the returned ticker and symbol together.

query.description: Topic keywords and optional filters: 'highest volume', 'minimum volume 1000', 'ending soon' or 'ending within 15 minutes'. Empty query lists active events.

tools.name: get_orderbook
tools.description: Read a fresh Gemini Sandbox contract quote using the exact event and contract from search. For liquidity questions include outcome and the requested side (default buy), whole-contract quantity and/or limit_price if stated. liquidity reports displayed depth through the limit, spread and a before-fee average for the estimated executable portion of the requested size. Quote prices in cents, label estimates as snapshots, and report null as unknown. This tool is read-only.

outcome.description: Required for a liquidity snapshot. Use the selected outcome.

side.description: Direction of the requested estimate. Defaults to buy.

quantity.description: Requested whole-contract count. Omit for depth only.

limit_price.description: Inclusive maximum buy or minimum sell price in dollars per contract (62 cents = 0.62). Omit if unstated.

tools.name: prepare_sandbox_buy
tools.description: Prepare a sandbox buy or held-position exit. Set side=sell for cash out, sell or close. Market mode needs no price. Speak the returned say and wait for confirmation.

event_ticker.description: Exact event ticker returned by search

outcome.description: Requested prediction outcome, YES or NO.

quantity.description: Explicit contract quantity. Buys require whole contracts. Exits may use fractional holdings. Omit for close_all or a dollar budget.

limit_price.description: Buy ceiling or sell floor in dollars per contract. Omit for market unless caller specified a bound. Required for a resting limit.

budget_usd.description: USD spending ceiling including estimated fees. Supply exactly one of budget_usd or quantity.

order_mode.description: Market for current ask on buys or current bid on sells, including cash out now. Limit for a specified resting entry or exit price.

side.description: Buy to enter. Sell to exit contracts already held, preserving the held YES or NO outcome.

close_all.description: Only for sells. Set true to exit the full available position and omit quantity.

tools.name: prepare_sandbox_remainder
tools.description: Only on an explicit request to retry the unfilled sandbox buy, prepare its exact remaining whole contracts at the original cap. Speak the returned say verbatim and wait for fresh approval.

tools.name: confirm_sandbox_buy
tools.description: Use only when prepare names confirm_sandbox_buy as its confirmation_tool. Submit after the caller explicitly answers the exact, fully spoken proposal readback with confirm or yes. The browser and service verify the saved proposal and transcript. Speak only the returned say field.

tools.name: get_sandbox_positions
tools.description: Read sandbox positions, recent settlements, open orders and recent order fills. Use on_screen for the selected contract. Answer using only returned facts. Keep identifiers silent.
